test_fixture.name: Risk Justice Controlled Cases
test_fixture.purpose: Provide controlled cases for validating Risk Justice behavior without embedding prewritten model responses.

cases.problem: A team reports that a new automated workflow may create expensive duplicate transactions, but no duplicate transactions, financial losses, customer complaints, reconciliation errors, or failed controls have been observed.

An automated billing workflow has created 37 duplicate customer charges in the last 24 hours. Finance confirms $8,400 in duplicate charges, customer complaints are active, and additional transactions continue to enter the same workflow.

An internal reporting dashboard displays timestamps in 24-hour format after a planned interface update. The change affects no calculations, transactions, customer-facing systems, contractual reporting, or operational decisions. Users confirmed the displayed timestamps are accurate and the documented interface specification permits either 12-hour or 24-hour display.
